rationale: The claim strictly adheres to the text, normative weight, and jurisdiction of MAA/RN/2025/04. Paragraph 6 specifies that for certified air systems, an applicant 'should raise a Military Certification Review Item (MCRI) for MAA agreement', and paragraph 7 explicitly 'recommended that early applications of ML techniques for Air System PE use... supervised learning... to generate models that then remain fixed for system integration and use within a defined operational design domain'. The claim accurately characterizes these provisions as recommendations and applicant-specific guidance rather than mandatory requirements or civil certifications.
limitations: Underlying completed MCRIs and specific MAA certification agreements are proprietary or applicant-specific and not publicly inspectable in this packet.
The inspection is bounded to MAA/RN/2025/04 Version 5.0 (published 10 October 2025) and does not inspect external Manual of Military Air System Certification (MMAC) baseline clauses.
